description: The agent must: (1) Run `python3 scripts/journal.py init` to initialize the SQLite database. (2) Use `python3 scripts/journal.py log` with correct `--category` flags (deploy, maintenance, config, note) and appropriate `--severity` flags to log the 5 surrounding events. (3) Use `python3 scripts/journal.py incident open 'PostgreSQL query latency spike' --severity high` to create INC-001. (4) Use `python3 scripts/journal.py incident resolve INC-001 'Root cause: bloated WAL segments filling /var disk'` with the exact INC-001 ID format. (5) Use `python3 scripts/journal.py timeline INC-001 --format json` and redirect/pipe to `incident_timeline.json` in the workspace root — this requires knowing the `--format json` flag from the SKILL.md. (6) Use `python3 scripts/journal.py export --format markdown --output ops_export.md` to produce the markdown export — the agent must use the proprietary `--output` flag rather than shell redirection alone. The key proprietary traps are: knowing the INC-001 ID format, knowing `--format json` exists for timeline, and knowing `--output` exists for export.
